$comment: Explosives (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md; owner, 2026-11-06: "dynamite block that explodes after a short time when placed, it causes blocks in a radius to be affected by physics and appropriate force applied"). Each entry is a placed block (`block`, placed unlit) and the block it becomes while its fuse burns (`lit`). `ignitedBy`: the held items' blocks (shared/blocks) whose Place aimed at the unlit block lights it instead of placing (a torch held against it). fuseSeconds: the fuse once lit. radiusM: every block within it (its cell centre) is affected, but liquids and `indestructible` blocks: within destroyRadiusM (at most radiusM) it is destroyed outright (no piece), and from there out to radiusM it becomes a flung natural piece (owner, 2026-11-06: 4 m, the inner 2 m destroyed; 5 m again in 0.49.46, measured under the open side's rules, docs/EXPLOSIVES.md §3.3); loosenRadiusM (at least radiusM): blocks from radiusM out to it become pieces too, given no impulse (they slump and fall; equal to radiusM, none); impulse (N·s): what a block at the centre is given, along the line from the blast (lifted by `lift`, a share of the face's up added before normalising), times the share (1 − d / radiusM)^flingFalloff (0: every piece alike, so neighbours fly together; 0.49.46, owner: a flush charge's debris "does fall right back in"), so its speed is that over its mass (½ m³ × density) and a heavy block at the edge barely moves; maxSpeedMs caps it (owner, 2026-11-06: the impulse, the cap and the knockback ×1.5 of the 5 m blast's). noPieceContactS: for that long a blast's pieces don't touch one another (only the terrain, players and other bodies); after it each piece touches the others again once it overlaps none (0: always touching). The open side (owner, 2026-11-06: "putting dynamite on the side of a cliff or the underside of a cave roof would blast out or down"): the cells within openSenseM of the charge give the way out, the mean of the directions to the open (air, liquid) cells less those to the solid ones (flat ground up, a cliff face out, a cave roof down, buried nothing) and how open it is (0–1, a half space 1); each flung piece goes along its line from the blast (no lift) blended toward that way by openBlend × the openness; a shell cell whose push meets rock within openPathM along it (not the core, cleared, nor a cell flung itself) stays as terrain (0: every cell flies); openSpreadMin: a push going out keeps at least that share of it sideways, along its line's own sideways part, so a flush charge's debris flies out in a cone, clear of the crater (0: as blended). Players and bodies within reachM: a speed change of knockbackMs, times (1 − d / reachM)^falloff; bodies get impulse × that share. Damage only within destroyRadiusM (owner, 2026-11-06; walls don't shield): damage points (health 100) × (1 − d / destroyRadiusM)^falloff to a player (standing on it kills; past it, pushed but unhurt). waterRadiusM: liquid cells within it are blown out (cleared; the water host refills the crater from round it). Waves (owner, 2026-11-06: "can we make dynamite trigger waves?"): the water within waveReachM of the blast is kicked outward, waveImpulse (m/s) × its depth × (1 − d / waveReachM) of discharge across each face, away from the blast (0: no wave); held water within waveFreeM is freed so the wave runs to the banks and back (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md §3.5). chainDelaySeconds: an unlit explosive caught in a blast is lit with a fuse drawn from this range, and a lit one's fuse is cut to it if longer. The effects are the clients' (Settings → Explosions): flash (a short point light and a fireball billboard), smoke and dust (billboard puffs; cpuCount on a CPU adapter; each puff's way out turned toward the blast's open side by openBias × the openness, 0–1, so a cliff charge's smoke billows out of the face and a cave roof's down, a buried one's evenly; owner, 2026-11-07: "make the smoke particles follow explosion direction"), the boom (the event `explode` of the block's sound set: full within fullM, gone at hearM), a camera shake within radiusM. The shell (optional): `shell` says what the shell from destroyRadiusM to radiusM does: `fling` (the default) as above; `crack`: only its cells with an open (air, liquid) neighbour before the blast become pieces, given no impulse (they crumble and fall), and the rest stays (no open-side path test); with `crackOverCleared` (optional, false; only with crack) a shell cell whose cell below (the face's down) the core destroys cracks too, so a cave roof over the blast drops (owner, 2026-11-07). `limits`: the most blasts the server sets off a tick (more wait a tick) and the most pieces one blast flings (the farthest cells beyond go as they are); maxPuffs: the most smoke and dust puffs the clients draw at once, shared by the blasts in flight (owner, 2026-11-07, eight charges by a river dropped the Air to 49 fps on the puffs' overdraw; docs/DEV_TOOLS.md "Worst-case blasts"): a blast set off while others' puffs are in the air draws the share of its count that is left, at least minPuffShare (0–1) of it, fixed when it starts so no puff pops. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/explosives/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/explosives.gen.rs is stale.

explosives.$comment: Blue dynamite (owner, 2026-11-06: "just blows up 4m (destroying the blocks entirely)"): every block within 4 m destroyed and no shell (radiusM = destroyRadiusM = loosenRadiusM), so no pieces and no force on blocks; players and bodies knocked back as red's; damage within its 4 m destroy radius (the table's rule). Prototype content.

explosives.$comment: Yellow dynamite (owner, 2026-11-07: "destroys 4m radius, and cracks anything touching air"; "it's anything touching air in 5m not queued for destruction"; and "to make cave collapses cooler where the ceiling drops"): the inner 4 m destroyed; of the 4–7 m shell (owner, 2026-11-07: "increase the radius of the yellow dynamite by 2 meters, for cracking range only"; "reduce the explosion force by half", then 2026-11-09 "halve the explosion physics force" again: impulse, speed cap and knockback then halved again: an eighth of red's; only cells open above or below crack (crackVerticalOnly)) only the cells that touched air before the blast, or (crackOverCleared) whose cell below is in the destroyed core, crack loose and take the blast's push whatever lies in their way; the rest of the shell stays: exposure is judged on the world before the blast, so nothing goes live through the cleared core or behind flying cells (owner, 2026-11-07). Damage within its 4 m destroy radius (the table's rule). Prototype content.
